text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Org surgecraft (org_id: sgc-881) sustained QPS spike detected -> 1800 qps sustained over 3m, org cap=300 qps, 5xx rate ↑ 3.2%. Paging on-call: @sam_oncall. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/alert/ALRT-5975312468

sam_oncall: taking this. brief impact check — are customers timing out downstream or hitting user-facing 429s?

maria: short summary: streaming API shows prefix cache miss storm, upstream backpressure causing request queueing and some 504s for streaming sockets. most errors are backend timeouts, not auth. I recommend temporary cap increase for surgecraft while we stabilize -- propose 1200 qps for 20m with automatic rollback.

kevin: can do. plan: POST to internal admin API to set temporary org_qps. will put a canary at 10% traffic first.

kevin: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/v1/orgs/sgc-881/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"override_qps":1200, "duration_sec":1200, "reason":"emergency-surge-surgecraft"}'
```

kevin: executed override -> ADMIN_EVT id=ovr-9021 applied by kevin, new_qps=1200, duration=20m. canary=10% route active.

incident-bot: EVENT: rate_limit_override applied: org=sgc-881 actor=kevin id=ovr-9021 expires_in=20m

support-bot: Notified account lead @amy_account and created ticket #15342 summarizing customer-visible timeouts. CS escalator pinged.

julia: monitoring: enabling canary dashboards. I set alert if 5xx > 2% over 5m or avg latency > 1.2s. If triggers, we rollback immediately.

maria: metrics after 3m: 5xx down from 3.2% -> 0.9%, median latency back to baseline. Backend CPU normalized. Looks stable.

sam_oncall: mitigation working. assigning handoff to @julia for 2h observation window. please capture runbook and commands in incident doc.

kevin: incident doc created: https://redwood.incidents/5975312468 — includes request payload, admin event id, and monitoring links. I've also scheduled automatic expiry; no manual rollback needed unless alerts fire.

sam_oncall: thanks all. Next steps: (1) julia to watch 2h, (2) postmortem to capture caching regression and improve prefix cache heuristics, (3) ops to consider a safer autoscaling ramp for the streaming workers. Closing pager for now. :white_check_mark:
